map.TOML 解析：逐行去空白，跳过空行与 # 注释（# 的判定需避开成对双引号内的: TOML parsing: trim each line, skipping blank lines and # comments (the # check must avoid content inside paired double quotes); [section] builds nested objects level by level on . and sets them as the current table, and [[array name]] appends a new element to the same-named array and sets it as the current table; other lines split at the first = into key and value, where the key forms a dotted path on . and the value first has its trailing # comment stripped and is then parsed. Value parsing: double-quoted strings are unescaped for \n \t \", true/false become booleans, pure integers use parseInt, pure decimals use parseFloat, and [ ] contents are parsed recursively comma-separated into arrays (an empty one returns an empty array). Output: keys matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ are written as-is, otherwise quoted with backslashes and quotes escaped; arrays are written as [a, b], strings are escaped and quoted; within a table scalar keys are written before sub-tables, with optional dictionary-order sorting
